messages:
samir: Quick sync — CloudBridge refarch and Terraform module for their marketplace listing. Need a short checklist before we publish the IA/C templates.

jess: Thanks. Can we confirm the module naming conventions and whether the examples include both GCP and AWS? Also need a minimal end-to-end deploy example. :clipboard:

maria: I'm on module linting. I saw the draft uses provider aliasing instead of separate modules per cloud — that's fine but we need clear vars and a README with network diagrams.

ryan: For the marketplace, legal wants an architecture diagram + data flow callouts (no PII). Tony, can CloudBridge provide their network topology SVG?

tony-cloudbridge: Yep — sending the SVG shortly. We use VPC peering + egress proxy for telemetry, nothing customer-identifying. Will upload to the shared drive.

samir: Great. Checklist proposal: 1) Terraform module (root) + examples/aws + examples/gcp, 2) README with diagram + security notes, 3) automated smoke test, 4) CI linting + terraform fmt and tflint, 5) marketplace metadata (manifest.yml). Thoughts?

jess: Add: a tiny end-to-end example using our hosted API credentials placeholder and a note on rate limits. Also include a canary config for Dedicated customers.

maria: I'll add a GitHub Action for fmt/lint and a smoke job that deploys to a sandbox project then runs a simple inference call. Example smoke step: ``terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve && curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'``

ryan: For the marketplace listing we need: short blurb (50-100 words), compliance badges, and a quickstart video link. Marketing can trim copy.

samir: Assign owners: module + examples -> maria, README + diagrams -> jess, marketplace manifest + blurb -> ryan, partner collateral + legal questions -> tony-cloudbridge. I'll own the final publish step.

tony-cloudbridge: Confirmed. Legal will review the manifest by EOD Friday. One ask: can we include a small sample terraform snippet that shows optional use of KMS?

jess: Yes — add an optional block commented out. e.g.
```hcl
module "redwood_refarch" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/ref-arch//modules/cloudbridge"
  region = var.region
  enable_kms = false # set true to enable CMEK
}
```

samir: Perfect. Maria — can you drop the initial PR by tomorrow morning? We'll do a lightweight review and merge if green.

maria: Yep, I'll open PR #342 with tests and GH Action. Expect draft by 09:30 PT.

dev-bot: CI triggered for branch refarch/cloudbridge (lint, fmt, smoke). Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/inspections/12345 :gear:

ryan: Once PR is merged, I'll prep the marketplace manifest and coordinate the partner announcement schedule. Prefer publish window: Tue morning to sync with CloudBridge comms.

samir: Ok — timeline locked. Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if any blockers show up in CI. :thumbsup:
